design_philosophy: A bold, distinctive anime catalog that breaks the 'dark mode tech' mold. It uses a 'Manga' inspired high-contrast mix of stark white and deep graphite, accented with vibrant Emerald Green. Typography is aggressive and editorial, using wide geometric sans for impact and clean sans for legibility.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento grids with strict optical alignment. Heavy use of asymmetrical column splits (e.g. 8-col / 4-col).
spacing_and_layout.borders: 1px solid crisp borders to mimic manga panels. No soft shadows; use hard drop-shadows or solid borders.

buttons.primary: bg-[#10B981] text-white rounded-none font-bold tracking-wide hover:bg-[#059669] transition-colors px-6 py-3
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#272A30] text-[#F3F4F6] rounded-none hover:bg-[#16181D] transition-colors

cards.anime_card: Relative positioning, aspect-[2/3] for cover art, zero border radius, inner gradient overlay at bottom for text contrast. Hover state: slight scale-up of image, border color shifts to Emerald.

navigation.header: Sticky z-50, backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#090A0C]/80, border-b border-[#272A30]. Light/dark mix context: when scrolling into light sections, header remains dark for contrast.

forms.inputs: bg-transparent border-b border-[#272A30] rounded-none focus:border-[#10B981] focus:ring-0 transition-all text-white placeholder-[#9CA3AF]

drawer.filters: Right-side drawer. Stark white background (#FFFFFF) with dark text (#111827) to create the 'Light/Dark Mix' contrast against the dark main catalog.

motion.hover_states: Crisp and immediate. Images scale by 1.05x. Borders snap to Emerald.
motion.page_transitions: Fade in with slight upward translation (framer-motion).

media.image_treatment: High contrast. Maximum overlay opacity on hero images bg-black/40. No heavy gradients.

hero_banner.description: Stunning sunset sky with silhouetted mountains, used for the main Discover page hero background.

hero_banner_secondary.description: Twilight skyline for profile or category banner.

anime_cover_placeholder_1.description: Abstract/character placeholder for anime cover art in grids.

anime_cover_placeholder_2.description: Alternative abstract placeholder for anime cover art.

scenery_placeholder.description: Scenery placeholder for episode thumbnails or related anime blocks.

specific_page_instructions.home_discover: Use a massive, edge-to-edge hero section with `hero_banner`. The carousels below (Top Airing, etc.) should use strict grid alignments. Section headers should be large `Cabinet Grotesk` typography.
specific_page_instructions.browse_catalog: Grid of anime cards. The filters drawer must pop out as a stark white (#FFFFFF) sidebar over the dark app, providing the requested 'light/dark mix'.
specific_page_instructions.anime_detail: Split layout. The top is a full-bleed banner. Below, left column (dark mode) contains the YouTube trailer embed and episodes. Right column (light mode panel, #F8F9FA) contains info, stats, and the comments thread. This reinforces the editorial, asymmetric manga look.
specific_page_instructions.profile: Clean bento-box grid for Watchlist, Favorites, and Ratings.

testing_requirements: All interactive elements, buttons, links, form inputs, tabs, and filter checkboxes MUST have role-based `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="play-trailer-button"`, `data-testid="filter-drawer-toggle"`).
tech_stack_notes: Use Lucide React for icons. Use standard HTML/Tailwind for the marketing/hero areas, and heavily customized Shadcn UI components for dropdowns, tabs, and drawers.
